title: POSTPONED: Nasdaq Announces the Launch of the NFN 0060 Data Format
summary: The NFN 0060 format launch (six- to nine-character decimal expansion, new ETF Summary format, new NFNDS message codes, 15-minute FTP pickup intervals) is postponed from 2026-08-10 to a date to be announced. NFN issuers, pricing agents and NFNDS subscribers affected.
